# Rocky Pass replay

`joakim.rp3` was contributed by Joakim for this benchmark and included at his
request. It is the unchanged Android replay: Rocky Pass, two laps, eight
Corvettes, traffic disabled. It contains saved race settings and replay data;
the track, car models, textures and audio are separate downloads.

SHA-256: `cc849bcc4e787379b23414b36080a0ef12132ac590fa97d42ebf94a66c65b07e`
(169,720 bytes).

See [benchmark setup and usage](../../../docs/fork/RENDERER_BENCHMARK.md).
